english.title: Possess false / improperly obtained / anothers identity document - Identity Cards Act 2006
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without reasonable excuse had in your possession or under your control

(A)_[an identity document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), that was false]_
(B)_[an identity document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), that was improperly obtained]_
(C)_[an identity document, namely **(..SPECIFY THE IDENTITY DOCUMENT..), that related to someone else]_
(D)_[apparatus, articles or material, namely **(..SPECIFY..), which to your knowledge was or had been specially designed or adapted to be used in the making of false identity documents]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 25(5) and (7) of the Identity Cards Act 2006.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For the current legislation, please see the Identity Documents Act 2010.

Indictable: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

None
